study.publisher_pdf_status: 403 at https://www.jamda.com/article/S1525-8610(12)00228-9/pdf; original journal PDF not recovered.

source_qualification.central_judgment: The exact twice-daily MPC80 beverage has randomized, source-qualified evidence of improved secondary physical performance over24 weeks in pre-frail/frail older adults. Primary total lean mass was null and neither leg-extension nor chair-rise interaction met alpha = .05. Preserve the functional positive as a preparation-specific compensation comparison without generic protein/whey efficacy, BUBR1 restoration, MVA benefit or superiority over provisional nominees.

intervention.active: 250 mL vanilla-flavored beverage containing15 g protein as milk protein concentrate MPC80, 7.1 g lactose, 0.5 g fat and 0.4 g calcium; one after breakfast and one after lunch for24 weeks.
intervention.provider: FrieslandCampina Consumer Products Europe, Wageningen, Netherlands.
intervention.daily_reported_totals: 500 mL beverage and30 g supplemental protein; twice the listed per-serving lactose/calcium.
intervention.comparator: 250 mL matching vanilla-flavored opaque-package beverage with no protein, 7.1 g lactose and0.4 g calcium, twice daily. No placebo-fat quantity or complete kcal label is supplied in the read chapter.
intervention.energy_interpretation: Reported formulation does not establish an energy-matched comparator. Added protein brings energy as well as nitrogen; protein-specific effects cannot be fully isolated from additional energy. No kcal value or unreported placebo ingredient was invented.
identity_limits: MPC80 is the source ingredient label, not an80:20 casein/whey declaration.
Whey/casein proportion, amino-acid profile, leucine content, batch assay, retail brand equivalence and current formulation are unverified.
No transfer to isolated whey, casein, all dairy products, all dietary protein, or a generic retail drink.
intervention.adherence: At least92%, assessed by ticked calendars and returned/non-consumed drinks; no between-group difference reported.
intervention.cointerventions: This target trial has no prescribed resistance-training program. Repeated strength testing/familiarization is distinct from a training intervention. Habitual activity changes were not reported in this chapter.

design.population: Men and women age>=65, pre-frail or frail by Fried criteria. Mean age78±1y protein and81±1y placebo; means±SEM. Exact proportions pre-frail versus frail not given in the recovered baseline table.
design.important_exclusions: Cancer,COPD, diabetes screened by fasting glucose>=7mmol/L, eGFR<60mL/min/1.73m2; no structured exercise-program history in prior2 years. Registry additionally names milk-protein allergy/sensitivity and anticoagulant use except acetylsalicylic acid.
design.allocation: Independent person; computer-generated random numbers; permuted blocks of 4 stratified by sex.
design.masking: Report titled double-blind; opaque vanilla packages described, biopsy image investigator blinded. Current registry lists quadruple masking. Specific target-chapter staff blinding/unblinding success and concealment implementation are not separately documented.
design.withdrawals: 8 withdrew,4 per arm;4 withdrawn participants agreed to final assessment. Reasons, returning-dropout allocation and endpoint-specific missingness by visit are not tabulated.
design.analysis: Authors describe intention-to-treat and an a priori data-analysis plan, with mixed linear models, Toeplitz covariance, time/treatment/interaction fixed and subject random. They state per-protocol results did not differ but do not provide those full estimates. Outcome-specific analysis samples are smaller than65; do not label all as65 completers.
design.primary: DXA total lean mass; planned 1.14 kg between-arm difference, SD 1.4 kg,power 80%,alpha .05,24 per arm minimum, 30 per arm targeted with25% dropout allowance. DXA lean tissue is not a direct measurement of contractile protein or faithful cell renewal.
design.secondary: Muscle fiber CSA, 1-RM leg strength,handgrip and SPPB; blood/diet/general health outcomes also described.
design.multiplicity: No recovered multiplicity correction or hierarchical gatekeeping plan. A secondary nominal P = .02 is retained as such; it does not become a primary endpoint or disappear because mass is null.
design.model_effect_limit: No adjusted between-arm change estimate or confidence interval is supplied. Printed means are rounded; no CI reconstructed from SEM.

outcomes.name: SPPB composite
outcomes.contrast: Treatment×time interactionP = .02 over the repeated intervention measurements.
outcomes.interpretation: A real nominal between-arm trajectory benefit. Roughly+1.1 versus+0.1 points from rounded means is descriptive only, not the adjusted model contrast. Baseline protein-group score was already1.1points higher. No separate balance-component effect, disability reduction, falls, hospitalization or survival benefit was measured here.

outcomes.name: Total lean mass
outcomes.contrast: No treatment,time or interaction significance reported, P > .05.
outcomes.interpretation: No detected mass benefit, not equivalence or exclusion of smaller effects.

outcomes.name: Leg press1-RM
outcomes.interpretation: Improvement in both groups is not a protein-specific benefit.

outcomes.name: Leg extension1-RM
outcomes.interpretation: Does not meet statedalpha = .05; not a confirmed between-arm strength gain.

outcomes.name: Handgrip
outcomes.contrast: No interaction or main effects, P > .05.

outcomes.name: Walking-time row labeled gait speed
outcomes.contrast: No interaction or main effects, P > .05.
outcomes.limit: Source reports seconds, not a velocity; no gait-speed benefit inferred.

outcomes.name: Chair-rise time
outcomes.interpretation: Does not meet the nominal alpha = .05. No multiplicity-corrected threshold was supplied. Table-versus-prose baseline discrepancy is retained.

outcomes.name: Other body composition
outcomes.result: No significant treatment,time or interaction effects;typeII fibers smaller than typeI overall.
outcomes.limit: Author-copy CSA unit label readsmm² beside values around3-5; no numerical fiber-area inference or silent rescaling is made.

outcomes.name: Habitual intake
outcomes.result: Diet excluding supplements showed no protein/macronutrient interaction; energy declined over timeP = .04,interactionP = .60. Reported total protein with supplements rose from about 1.0 to 1.4 g/kg/day in protein arm.

outcomes.name: Blood and general health
outcomes.result: Glucose,insulin,eGFR,SF-12,blood pressure andMMSE reportedly unchanged over time/in groups;follow-up numeric results are data not shown.

registry.current_primary: Change in skeletal muscle mass at baseline,3 months,6 months
registry.current_secondary: Physical performance,blood parameters,diet,physical activity,cognition and blood pressure; detailed instrument-wise endpoint hierarchy not supplied.
registry.interpretation: First submission/posting followed the stated study start and recruitment start. Current record agrees broadly with primary/secondary roles, but original registration version/SAP were not recovered; do not claim fully prospective unmodified prespecification.

safety.reported: Discussion states no health complaints/side effects and no renal-function effect over24 weeks;adherence>=92%.
safety.limits: No adverse-event table,ascertainment protocol,adjudication,serious-event counts or withdrawal reasons recovered;renal follow-up is data not shown. Baseline renal disease and major illness exclusions restrict applicability. This is not proof of universal tolerability,renal safety or safety for a child withMVA.

findings_verbatim.finding: Author, title, journal identification and abstract agree with PMID 22889730 / DOI 10.1016/j.jamda.2012.07.005. The complete author thesis report is an adequate stated primary reading basis; journal-version byte equivalence, journal-native PDF, supplement/SAP or registry-history reading is not claimed.

250 mL twice daily after breakfast/lunch for 24 weeks, 15 g MPC80 protein per serving, 7.1 g lactose, 0.5 g fat and 0.4 g calcium match the source. Placebo lists no protein, the same lactose/calcium, and no fat/calorie specification. The comparison cannot establish protein-specific isolation from added energy. No invented calorie total, casein:whey ratio, isolated-whey identity, amino-acid profile or retail equivalence is introduced.

65 randomized (34 protein/31 placebo), eight withdrawals (four per arm) and four final-returning withdrawals are retained without treating 65 as completers. Outcome analysis n remains DXA 62, SPPB/gait 61, 1-RM 50, chair-rise 48, fiber CSA 46, handgrip/body weight 65. Allocation is independently generated, sex stratified in blocks of four. Primary lean mass and secondary strength/function roles and mixed-model/Toeplitz analysis are preserved.

findings_verbatim.topic: Functional positive versus primary and strength nulls
findings_verbatim.finding: SPPB 8.9±0.6 to 10.0±0.6 versus 7.8±0.6 to 7.9±0.6, interaction P=.02, is a nominal secondary trajectory benefit. The baseline imbalance and rounded descriptive changes are explicit; no adjusted difference/CI is invented. Primary lean mass is null, leg-extension P=.059 and chair-rise P=.055 do not meet alpha .05, and common within-arm strength improvement is not an added protein effect. No falls/disability/mortality benefit was measured.

locators: Chapter 3 statistical Methods and withdrawal paragraph
findings_verbatim.finding: The stated a priori plan is not independently recovered; no multiplicity/hierarchical gate is shown. Missingness reasons and arm-by-visit denominator mapping are not tabulated, and per-protocol similarity has no full estimates. Chair protein baseline 13.2 seconds in the table versus 13.7 in prose, fiber-CSA mm² label, and gait-in-seconds label remain unrepaired source discrepancies. Diet effects exclude supplements and do not remove the energy contrast.

locators: Chapter 3 Discussion and unshown follow-up results
findings_verbatim.finding: Registry start November 2009 and chapter recruitment December 2009 predate first submission February 2010 and posting April 2010; 2025 current-record update is not original prospective prespecification. Reported no side effects/renal change is limited by unshown follow-up, absent event/withdrawal tables and restricted eligibility. Provider, research framework and printing sponsorship are separated; the no-conflict phrase is attributed only to the indexed publisher excerpt, not a recovered full declaration page.

The 62-person exercise-background trial has a separate registry and both arms trained twice weekly. Its abstract reports lean-mass interaction P=.006 and no added strength/SPPB interaction. The limited companion reading is correctly attributed, no pooling or mass-gain transfer occurs, and individual participant independence is not assumed.

All eight exact linked identities were resolved: one editorial and seven perspective/comment letters, with no correction/retraction classification or explicit correction/error title encountered. They all link to both trial reports. No abstracts or full bodies were qualified. Substantive critique is therefore not adjudicated, and this metadata result neither erases the reported functional positive nor certifies its robustness.
